releases.body:
Adds designer and writer specialists and improved orchestrator delegation

### Added
- designer specialist agent for user flows
- writer specialist agent for docs

### Changed
- orchestrator now wont delegate a task on a worker agent that doesn't support the scope
- workers can now reject tasks that is not in their scope and pass it to another worker best for the task
- orchestrator will now now stop and notify the user that both primary and fallback models on a worker is unavailable

### Install
```shell
opencode plugin add openchoreographer
```
```shell
npx openchoreographer --no-plugin
```

### Upgrade

```shell
opencode plugin update
```
```shell
npx openchoreographer --force
```

## What's Changed
* Agents optimization by @x01Jin in https://github.com/x01Jin/openchoreographer/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/x01Jin/openchoreographer/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0

Settings and step budgets
- `/choreographer` opens an in-TUI settings panel for TODO and RUNNING animations, TODO panel visibility, agent roster visibility, and per-agent step budgets.
- Step budgets are written to the agent definition files and survive installer upgrades. `--reset-steps` restores the bundled defaults.

TUI performance
- Streaming deltas no longer refresh the sidebar; structural events are coalesced and status events filtered.
- Memoized roster and model lookups, cheaper animation frames, debounced step writes, and cell-accurate truncation.

Fallback and tooling
- Quota failures returned as completed subagent results now retry on the configured fallback, including agents whose model comes from config.
- Optional `stat: true` on the diff tool returns a patch-free summary.
- Token trims in the orchestrator, reviewer, and TODO prompts.

Install
```sh
opencode plugin add openchoreographer
npx openchoreographer --no-plugin
```

Upgrade
```sh
opencode plugin update
npx openchoreographer --force
```
